out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink next to the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at handwashing sink during the inspection.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the kitchen is blocked by shelving units, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC moved the shelving units away from handwashing sink during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the handwashing sink next to the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC provided a visible sign “Hand washing only” at handwashing sink during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Beef base at 48F, Sliced Swiss cheese at 46F stored in 2 DR prep cooler; Observed Milk at 45F, Cottage cheese at 66F, Cream cheese at 71F stored on the buffet counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all aforementioned food items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed dishwasher machine and steamer Evolution are not in working conditions.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC submitted the tickets for repair prior of inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the handwashing sink faucet is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC contacted a plumber during the inspection. A plumber arrived during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC was not able to provide Certified Food Manager certification.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please obtain heat sensitive test strip before the follow-up inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please repair the 3 -compartment sink’ faucet before the follow-up inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: beef vegetable soup at 45F in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded beef vegetable soup.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Observed beef vegetable soup at 45F in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC discarded beef vegetable soup. The proper cooling methods were discussed with PIC.
